edges.sentence: On 2026-10-06, Al Jazeera reported “Earlier, Health Secretary Duale said 28 contacts, including family members and health workers who cared for the patient, had been identified.”; on the same day, PBS NewsHour reported “Duale said that 28 contacts of the man who had returned on Saturday, including family members and health workers who cared for the patient, had been identified.”.

On 2026-10-06, Associated Press reported “Kenya confirms first Ebola case imported from Congo”; on the same day, Al Jazeera reported “Kenya has confirmed its first Ebola case after the death of a Kenyan national in Nairobi, who had returned from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC).”.

new_slots.name: quarantined family members
new_slots.sentence: Seeking to halt local transmission, Kenya’s President William Ruto said at least eight family members of the victim and 21 healthcare workers have been quarantined, as he ordered an enhanced response to contain the virus in the country.

new_slots.name: duration of illness
new_slots.sentence: The patient, who had lived in the DRC for seven years, had been ill for about a month before travelling by road from the DRC to Uganda’s capital, Kampala, and then flying to Nairobi on Saturday, Aden Duale, Kenya’s health secretary, told a news conference on Tuesday.

new_slots.sentence: Kenya, a popular destination for travelers from the U.S., Asia and Europe, had until now dodged the deadly virus.
